test_title: PYST 17: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A cistern has a hole in the bottom through which the water is leaking. A tap can fill the cistern in 6 hours and the hole in the bottom can empty the fully filled cistern in 15 hours. If both the tap and the hole are open, then what will be the time taken to completely fill the empty cistern?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by the tap to fill the cistern = 6 hours

Time taken by the hole to empty the cistern = 15 hours

**Formula used:**

Net filling rate when both are open = Filling rate of the tap - Emptying rate of the hole

Total time to fill = 1 / Net fill
